notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend was run and the wire syntax was not tried on an instrument. The package is a ScpiDriver command map for the LeCroy WaveRunner 104MXi-A over the clone's LeCroy SCPI lines: it reads and writes the trigger mode (TRMD), acquisition type (:acquire:type), sample mode (:acquire:mode), number of averages (:acquire:count) and timebase mode/reference (:timebase:mode, :timebase:reference), and reads the frequency, period and peak-to-peak voltage measurement of channel C1 (:measure:<function>? C1). The e-stop writes :stop, the clone's continuous-acquisition stop command. NOT COVERED: waveform (C1:WAVEFORM?) and screenshot (HCSU/SCDP) transfers (large arrays; the fake is a reply table and returns none), the trigger type TRSE (a comma-separated reply this read map cannot split) and the channel settings C1:SCALE/OFFSET/TRLV (the clone states no bound for them). The declared risk is R1, not the card's R0 floor, because cap.device.configure.v1 has class floor R1 (SAFE-007); the e-stop and safe_state sentence that R1 requires are declared. The clone sends CHDR OFF when it constructs its driver, and this bridge has no configure-before-identity step, so the reads assume the command header is off (facts.md). The fake replies are placeholders, not recordings. gate.digest is the digest the check printed (report without its clock); check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-10-29; reviewed_by stays null): accepted: the oscilloscope's own measurements and settings; waveform and screenshot transfers are not covered. The reviewer changed no file of the package. After the registry rebuild refreshed task.json, the reviewer re-ran the gate and wrote its digest above.
